full_prompt_en: An old-fashioned monochrome drawing shows a seated musician absorbed in playing a small bowed string instrument. His dark wavy hair and pronounced moustache frame a downward-facing profile. He wears a loose light shirt with full sleeves, a patterned dark vest, and pale trousers gathered around one raised knee. The instrument rests across his lap and chest, its narrow neck extending toward the right while one hand works near the fingerboard and the other draws a slim bow. He sits on a low stool, surrounded by loosely suggested grasses, papers, or rough ground marks that fade before reaching the margins. Behind him, fragmentary architectural and foliage shapes appear as faint crosshatched patches rather than a fully built setting. The linework is strongest around the face, hands, instrument, and folded clothing, where black hatching accumulates into deep shadows. Elsewhere the pencil-like strokes thin rapidly into the warm off-white paper. Different mark directions distinguish soft fabric, carved instrument wood, hair, and ground. The composition forms a stable triangular mass from the shoulders through the bent leg and back to the seat, while the instrument neck adds a long diagonal. There is no color beyond the subtle warmth of the paper, leaving gesture and tonal craft to carry the scene. The whole frame feels like a remembered folk performance preserved in patient engraved lines.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅古旧风格的单色素描描绘一位坐着的乐手专注演奏小型弓弦乐器。深色波浪发与明显的胡须围住向下的侧脸。他穿宽松、袖子蓬起的浅色衬衣、有纹样的深色背心，以及在抬起的膝头周围褶起的浅色长裤。乐器横在膝上和胸前，细长琴颈伸向右侧，一只手在指板附近活动，另一只手拉着纤细的弓。他坐在低凳上，周围是松散暗示的草、纸片或粗糙地面笔迹，在碰到画面边缘前就渐渐消散。身后零碎的建筑与叶片形态只是浅淡的交叉排线色片，而非完整建成的环境。脸、手、乐器和衣物褶皱附近的线条最有力，黑色排线聚成深影。其他地方，铅笔般的笔迹迅速变淡，融入暖白纸面。不同方向的笔触区分柔软布料、木制乐器、头发与地面。肩膀、弯曲的腿和座位构成稳定的三角形体量，琴颈又添上一道长斜线。除纸面的微暖外没有颜色，场景完全由姿态和明暗技艺承载。整幅画像一场被耐心的雕刻式线条保存下来的民间演奏记忆。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome illustration has the look of a fine nineteenth-century engraving on warm off-white paper. Dense crosshatching and black contour accents gather in a compact central area, then dissolve into faint broken strokes and open margins. Different line directions describe fabric folds, hair, polished hard surfaces, and rough ground without relying on color. A stable triangular core is animated by one long thin diagonal. Darkest values sit at overlapping forms and small contact points; broad light areas stay mostly unmarked, allowing the paper to provide illumination. The background appears only in fragments, with airy sketch patches rather than a continuous environment. The marks range from sharp etched lines to soft pencil-like shading, preserving a handmade, archival character. The whole frame feels observant and nostalgic through patient tonal drawing and generous white space.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅单色插画具有十九世纪精细版画印在暖白纸上的面貌。密集交叉排线和黑色轮廓重点聚在紧凑的中央区域，随后消融为浅淡、断续的笔迹和敞开的边缘。不同方向的线条区分布料褶皱、头发、光滑硬质表面与粗糙地面，无须依靠颜色。稳定的三角形核心被一道细长斜线带动。最深明度落在重叠形体与小处接触点，宽阔亮区则几乎不落笔，让纸张本身提供光。背景只以片段出现，是透气的草图色片，而非连续环境。笔迹从锋利刻线到柔软的铅笔式排影变化，保留手工与档案般的气质。整幅画借助耐心的明暗素描与宽裕留白，显得细察入微而带怀旧感。
theme_en: A seated fiddler in an old engraving
theme_zh: 古旧版画中的坐姿提琴手
name: Mark Schultz
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
